scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma')) fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma');" && npm install --no-save prisma@5.22.0 && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma'); console.log('Prisma set to local SQLite.');" && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:render: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma'); console.log('Prisma set to Render PostgreSQL.');" && npx prisma generate
